### Building reliable data systems that turn complex data into decisions

I am a Data Engineer with more than five years of experience building reliable,
scalable, and production-ready data platforms across AWS and Azure.

I am an M.S. in Data Science graduate of **Willamette University**. My capstone project [forecasts future U.S. unemployment](capstone.qmd) at three-, six-, and twelve-month horizons using public macroeconomic data, chronological model evaluation, and historical lead–lag analysis.

**Currently seeking Data Engineer opportunities.** [Get in touch](about.qmd) or view my [resume](resume.qmd).
